query:
INSERT INTO characters (
            user_id, first_name, last_name, class, race, sex, is_main, level, reached_60_at
        )
        VALUES (
            $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, COALESCE($8::smallint, 1),
            CASE WHEN $8::smallint = 60 THEN COALESCE($9, now()) END
        )
        RETURNING id
